entry.summary: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 1: Touch Grass Pick any October afternoon in Phnom Penh. Around four or five o'clock the sky dumps what feels like a month of rain in twenty minutes, then stops like nothing happened. In a lot of Touch Grass entries this is where you'd go outside and look at leaves turning orange. We don't have that.
